findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.citation_text:
4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

Numerous dead bugs are observed around the inside rim of the display chest freezer in front of the register. The PIC is instructed to clean and maintain clean moving forward. Ensure that all surfaces are maintained clean at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

The mop is observed being stored in dirty mop water in the bathroom. The PIC was notified and instructed to stored so that it can drip dry when not in use. Ensure proper storage moving forward.
